evidence_items.publisher: Project NANDA authors; copy hosted by MLQ
evidence_items.locator: Section 4.3, page 12, Barriers to core workflow integration
evidence_items.explanation: The report records users identifying missing adaptation, memory and workflow fit, including this complaint. Its broader findings document stalled enterprise implementations, supporting both practical limitations and user recognition during the January–June research period.

evidence_items.publisher: Project NANDA authors; copy hosted by MLQ
evidence_items.locator: Section 3, page 6, paragraph on enterprise users of ChatGPT and Copilot
evidence_items.explanation: The same enterprise research reports positive experiences with general-purpose assistants used at work, as well as successful implementations elsewhere in the report. This contradicts an unqualified conclusion that the products fail to deliver useful functions.

unresolved_gaps: The study does not provide a representative estimate of failure across all enterprise generative AI products.
It does not establish a population-wide increase in awareness over time.
The report gives July 2025 without an exact release day; available_at conservatively records independently verified public availability by August 20.
